maya: Quick sync — I'm dropping tiny-sage-v2-quant weights to gs://rw-models/tiny-sage/v2/weights-2026-03-18. Can someone sanity-check tokenizer + runtime config before I kick off the onboarding job? Need: tokenizer vocab/tokenizer.json, special token mapping, and model_config.yaml.
chris: @maya got it. Which tokenizer variant is this — byte-level BPE, or the HF `tokenizer.json` export? Also any nonstandard special tokens?
sasha: quick Q: are the sentinel IDs stable? last time we saw a shift-by-one in the exported mapping and it wrecked chat templates. :eyes:
maya: It's the HF `tokenizer.json` (from tokenizers v0.15). I added user/assistant sentinels: `<|user|>` and `<|assistant|>`. I also noticed examples where BOS/EOS behavior toggles — for inference we probably want `add_bos=False`. Pasting tiny snippet of the token info I have: ```json
{"special_tokens": {"<|user|>": 50256, "<|assistant|>": 50257, "eos_token_id": 50256}, "add_bos": false}
```
julio: heads-up: our legacy quant kernels (and some kernel selection heuristics) treat IDs >=50000 differently — they can get masked in a few token-embedding lookup paths. If those sentinel IDs are >=50000 we should remap them into the <50000 range to avoid surprises.
chris: good catch. We can add a lightweight remap in `model_config.yaml` under `token_replacements` before loading the tokenizer, e.g.: ```yaml
special_tokens:
  "<|user|>": 49998
  "<|assistant|>": 49999
```
then stash the original ids in metadata. That way runtime sees the safe ids but we still preserve original mapping for eval.
sasha: also double-check `eos_token_id` vs `pad_token_id`. In our chat template code we rely on `eos_token_id` to flush KV cache and trigger response completion. If eos==user_sentinel it will break stopping heuristics.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: weights object exists at gs://rw-models/tiny-sage/v2/weights-2026-03-18 (sha256 matched), container image tag `tiny-sage-v2:20260318`, infra quotas ok, reserve pool available. (automated) :white_check_mark:
maya: Confirmed sha256: 8c3f2a9d... matched after upload. I also uploaded `tokenizer.json` and `vocab.json` to the same folder.
julio: I'll run a local smoke test with the remapped tokens and quant kernels. Plan: load weights -> apply `token_replacements` -> run a two-turn chat and inspect logits at sentinel positions. Will post logs.
chris: ping me once smoke is green and I'll approve the onboarding job (I want to ensure canary routing is set).
sasha: FYI we should create a canary route in Dedicated: `model: tiny-sage-v2; traffic: 5%` + automatic rollback on >0.5% error rate in 5m window. I'll add it to the rollout policy.
maya: Thanks — targeting onboarding at 15:10 PST. I'll kick job after your thumbs up. :pray:
julio: smoke passed locally. Sample convo:
```
User: Hello
Assistant: Hello! How can I help?
```
Log excerpt: `OK - forward completed; sentinel logits finite; eos emitted at tok 73 as expected`
julio: Notes: remapped `<|user|>`->49998 `<|assistant|>`->49999; runtime loaded model_config.yaml and selected quant kernel `q8_ggml` without mask error.
chris: Awesome. Approved. Please start onboarding — I'll watch canary metrics. :thumbsup:
maya: Onboarding started by deploy-bot at 2943210450. I'll update if anything fails.
deploy-bot: onboarding job tiny-sage-v2 started (job_id: onboard-2943210450). Canary route prepped (5%). Will report progress here.
maya: Closing loop: if we need to keep original sentinel ids for downstream evals, I'll add `orig_special_ids.json` to the model folder and include it in the model metadata. Thanks everyone!
